Window: This table reports cumulative market-adjusted abnormal returns (daily CRSP return minus the CRSP value-weighted market return, x100, summed over trading days) over three pre-event windows. In the primary panel, day 0 is the trading day nearest the breach date, identical to the main CAR anchor with its +/-50 calendar-day pull. In the secondary panel, day 0 is the trading day nearest the reported date; 1 of 354 CRSP-sample events are excluded for a missing or invalid reported date (including delay_invalid = 1 wrong-field records). Events lacking 30 complete pre-anchor trading days of abnormal returns are excluded listwise per panel (breach-anchored: 0; announcement-anchored: 0).
